claims.claim: Opens with Jonathan Harker's journal, kept in shorthand
claims.evidence: '(Kept in shorthand.)'

claims.claim: Harker is an English solicitor travelling east across Europe to Transylvania
claims.evidence: Munich, Vienna, Buda-Pesth, Bistritz; 'Solicitor—for just before leaving'

claims.claim: Going to the Carpathians to see Count Dracula about a property purchase
claims.evidence: 'explain the purchase of a London estate to a foreigner'; 'Carpathians'

claims.claim: He notes food and trains, reads up on the country
claims.evidence: 'paprika hendl'; 'hour late'; 'He clearly had studied beforehand' / reading in the library

claims.claim: Harker finds himself a prisoner in the castle
claims.evidence: 'The castle is a veritable prison, and I am a prisoner!'

claims.claim: He escapes
claims.evidence: later letter from Hospital of St. Joseph and Ste. Mary, Buda-Pesth: 'brain fever'

claims.claim: Dracula sails to Whitby (Demeter, from Varna)
claims.evidence: 'Whitby from Varna in the Demeter'

claims.claim: Preys on Lucy Westenra, who dies and becomes a vampire
claims.evidence: 'Lucy was bitten by such a bat'; 'she is Un-Dead'

claims.claim: Seward, Van Helsing, Holmwood, Morris and Jonathan with Mina destroy Lucy and hunt the Count
claims.evidence: 'Count me in'; Kukri/bowie; band of men

claims.claim: The Count has bitten Mina
claims.evidence: 'Unclean, unclean!'; bedroom scene

claims.claim: He flees by ship to Varna; they follow to Transylvania
claims.evidence: 'for Varna, and thence on to other parts and up the...'; 'we can travel overland'

claims.claim: Just before sunset they catch his cart
claims.evidence: 'finishing their task before the sun should set'; 'The sun was almost down'

claims.claim: Jonathan cuts his throat, Quincey stabs his heart, he crumbles to dust
claims.evidence: 'Jonathan's great knife... shear through the throat; Mr. Morris's bowie knife plunged into the heart'; 'crumbled into dust'

claims.claim: Quincey dies of his wounds
claims.evidence: 'the day on which Quincey Morris died'; 'blood was spurting through his fingers'

claims.claim: Jonathan Harker: English solicitor, Mina's husband
claims.evidence: text

claims.claim: Mina Harker: born Mina Murray, schoolmistress, Lucy's friend
claims.evidence: 'Mina Murray's Journal'; 'The life of an assistant schoolmistress'

claims.claim: Dracula: Transylvanian nobleman who is a vampire
claims.evidence: text

claims.claim: Lucy: courted by three men, Dracula's first English victim
claims.evidence: 'THREE proposals in one day!'

claims.claim: Seward: asylum doctor, Lucy's suitor, phonograph diary
claims.evidence: 'immense lunatic asylum'; 'Dr. Seward's Phonograph Diary'

claims.claim: Van Helsing: Dutch professor, Seward's old teacher
claims.evidence: 'my old friend and master, Professor Van Helsing, of Amsterdam'; 'the Dutchman'

claims.claim: Arthur Holmwood: Lord Godalming, Lucy's fiance
claims.evidence: 'Lord Godalming'; Lucy's engagement

claims.claim: Quincey Morris: Texan, Lucy's other suitor
claims.evidence: 'an American from Texas'; 'Mr. Quincey Morris, of Texas'
